tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: What Holos33 is, its launch status, who it is for and not for, the company behind it, the six modules and the official links. Start here.

tools.name: list_modules
tools.description: The six wellbeing modules (stress, sleep, breathing, hypnosis, nutrition, movement) with a one-line summary and URL.

tools.name: get_module
tools.description: Full text of one module as Markdown, with related knowledge-base articles.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Keyword search across Holos33 knowledge-base articles, modules, site pages and FAQ. Returns titles, summaries and URLs; fetch full text with get_article, get_module or get_page.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Full text of one knowledge-base article as Markdown, with publication date, categories and the translated version's URL.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Full text of one holos33.com page as Markdown, including legal and privacy pages. Long pages come in parts.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Frequently asked questions and answers. Answers that conflict with the current Early Access terms are left out.

tools.name: get_access_and_pricing
tools.description: Current price (free Early Access), fair-use limits, who can join, supported wearables, what happens after Early Access, and the waitlist link.

tools.name: get_privacy_and_data
tools.description: Where data is stored, how health-related data is handled under the GDPR, who the controller is, and links to the privacy policy and sub-processor register.

tools.name: get_partner_info
tools.description: What Holos33 offers coaches and therapists, organisations, research partners or investors, and where to take the next step (demo, partner interest).

tools.name: get_contact_and_links
tools.description: Company details and official links: waitlist, business demo, partner interest, contact form, FAQ and legal pages.
